observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: an indoor or covered outdoor patio area decorated with colorful ribbons, streamers, and a sign reading 'CIA DE DANÇAS', during a performance or cultural event
observation.dancers: group of mixed gender dancers (approx. 4 men and 4 women) in adult age
observation.formation_and_space: dancers alternate between forming circles holding hands, spinning individually, pairing up, and moving in loose groups across the floor
observation.posture: upright torso, relaxed knees, dynamic and bouncy weight transfer
observation.footwork: quick stepping patterns with light heel-toe action, pivots and turns on the beat; exact foot articulation partially obscured by skirts and pants legs
observation.arms_and_hands: arms raised holding hands in circle formations, swinging freely, holding and fluttering skirt hems, or gesturing outward
observation.hips_and_torso: natural hip movement and torso twisting accompanying turns and steps, without exaggerated isolation
observation.partnering: frequent hand-holding in circles, occasional paired holding and twirling, and brief embraces
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent fast spins, circular turns in pairs and groups, low squats during partner sections
observation.costume_and_props: women wear colorful floral skirts (red, yellow, green), off-the-shoulder blouses, and floral headpieces; men wear colorful floral pattern long-sleeve shirts, white trousers, and decorated straw hats; transparent face masks are worn by all
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and rapid heel-toe details are partially obscured by long skirts, rapid camera movement, and video compression

signature_moments.what: dancers link hands and travel in a brisk circular path with lively stepping
group joins hands in a wide circle, spinning and stepping rapidly around the center
dancers raise arms high while stepping in place and circling each other
dancers form a circle and swing their arms outward and inward on the beat
couples pair up into close embrace positions and spin together with energetic footwork
